p.x:
I recorded someone guide himself into a Jhana live on my podcast. And he narrated the whole process from start to finish.

Jhanas are meditative bliss states and they traditionally require thousands of hours of practice. But Stephen and his team at @jhanatech are changing that—creating retreats where most participants hit a Jhana in their first week.

I went to one of their retreats earlier this year, and it was by far the best I’ve been to. So I had Stephen on @every’s AI & I to show us how he gets into a Jhana and what the future of super wellbeing might look like:

- The mechanics of Jhana meditation—specifically, how it’s about resting into what already exists rather than reaching a new state of consciousness.
- How you can reset your emotional defaults—or “hack your personality”—by holding negative and positive emotions together and reshaping your response to triggers
- The potential pitfalls of Jhana, including how welcoming difficult emotions you aren't ready for can backfire—and grounding exercises that help.
- How Stephen uses AI at Jhourney—and the app he wants to build to make Jhanas learnable at scale.

This is a must-watch if you’re curious about the practice of Jhana meditation—or ever wondered if there’s more to meditation than sitting and breathing.

Watch below!
